superseded_candidate_batch.reason: Retaken after the atomic assembly correction; excluded from accepted aggregates.

limits: Sequential observations on a shared Mac, not isolated or randomized trials.
Cold means fresh daemon startup; ordinary/shared timing edits change comments, not semantic exports.
Only batch 2 counts for long-run memory; first baseline batch used harness v1 with the same comment-edit timing method.
Mixed memory runs execute cold oracle subprocesses during first occurrences of five states; resident RSS can shift. Full-series failures are preserved.
RSS median comparisons do not prove retained-object reduction. Weak-reference tests are bounded regression evidence, not a general leak proof.
Stage counters use separate in-process JSON checks; timings are not interchangeable with daemon text benchmarks or earlier profiled timings.
No Rust/native implementation or real-project detection-accuracy study was performed.
